say: Боитесь, что готовая лестница не впишется в дом?

why: Серия 1 «Лестница целиком — и вблизи»: формат «итог целиком, потом детали», как у ролика lestnisa.uz (около 1,8 млн просмотров), с хуком-вопросом о боли владельца дома. Цель — показать по четырём фото одной лестницы реальные ступени, соединения и отделку, а видео K0057 подать отдельно с подписью «другой объект».
rules: GEDA: only the client's own materials. 4 photos 001–004 show ONE finished staircase (dark steps, white elements, brick walls); the video K0057_Mikhail.mp4 is a DIFFERENT object without railing. Never present the photo staircase and the video as the same staircase: separate them clearly (e.g. a caption «другой объект»). No foreign footage, no stock, no AI presenter, no change of geometry. Overview first, then smooth movement to details: steps, joints, railing, wood texture.

problems: Frames 1-2 show the same shot with the same hook text, so a static, repeating picture runs for about 4 seconds
Frames 6-7 are near-identical, and frames 5-7 stay on the same angle with almost no movement
The captions are fragmented and out of sync with the picture: 'готовая лестница' is shown over a custom staircase, and 'видно вблизи' appears over a wide shot rather than a close-up
The video goes straight to a brand slate for 'Тереха / Лестницы ФЕБ' instead of GEDA, which is a wrong brand and a wrong name
The ending has no clear call to action and no contact details; 'Ещё 6 роликов за неделю' is irrelevant agency text for the viewer
qa.fix: Rebuild it as a smooth overview-to-detail move over photos 001-004 (full staircase, then steps, joints, railing, wood texture), with captions in sync with the voice, GEDA branding, and a final frame saying 'Напишите нам' with contact details instead of the agency slate.
